What is Click & Collect?
​Using Click & Collect, you can order your favourite products online and collect them from the click and collect area close to you.

Benefits of Click & Collect
• Shop and pick up your products at your convenience
​• Pay securely online with your preferred mode of payment

​• Pay securely online with your preferred mode of payment
​• Choose the collection slot that suits your needs the best, at your own pace​
Free* Click & Collect
As an IKEA Family member, you get to enjoy Click & Collect at no extra cost. Shop from the comfort of your home, choose a time that works for you, and simply collect your order in-store -quick, easy,
your home, choose a time that works for you, and simply collect your order in-store -quick, easy, and free.
